(4) SPCX buzz is very high: +7.35% Friday to $158.96, but about 30% below its $225.64 June 15 all-time high and only modestly above its $135 IPO price. Speculative rebound. (6) XYZ: sentiment and an analyst catalyst (Baird 'Bullish Fresh Pick'), but chatter is not rising and I found no chart data. REJECTED, as the brief says: NKE (most-mentioned but an earnings-miss selloff, -3.6%) and WDC (the mention spike came as the stock broke down, -12%+ Friday). RKLB was not added as a candidate: retail sentiment turned bearish and the '2-week rally is on the line'. Reddit (RDDT) showed $146.54, +2.88%, in a Benzinga Oct 2026 item, but the Stocktwits 'fresh highs' articles I found may be stale, so it is unverified. Not found (shown as 'null' in the data): market caps for MU, TSLA and XYZ; NVDA's exact Friday close; any XYZ price or trend data. Bottom line: NVDA is the best social-buzz pick with a strong chart. TSLA and SPCX are the best 'buzz plus rebound' alternatives if the episode wants a non-megacap-semis name, but neither is near its highs.
themes:
I used all 10 WebSearch calls. The hottest themes I could confirm for late Sep to early Oct 2026 are below.

(1) AI chips and foundry. Intel rose more than 30% in September and is up more than 200% YTD.

(2) AI storage, but only flash and memory. Everpure (ticker P) was September's best S&P 500 stock at +40.70%. On Fri Oct 2, hard-drive makers sold off after reports that Toshiba will double its HDD capacity for AI data centers by fiscal 2027: Seagate fell about 10% intraday to about $849.79, and Western Digital fell 7-10%. Micron and SanDisk were hit less, so this was an HDD problem, not a memory problem.

(3) Power for AI. Bloom Energy rose more than 30% in September, is up more than 200% YTD and is up about 233% over 1 year.

(4) S&P 500 index additions. Bloom Energy, Everpure and Illumina joined the index on Sep 21 and rallied into it.

(5) Space. Yes, SpaceX is public as SPCX. It closed Fri Oct 2 at $158.96, up 7.35% on the day and about 6.9% on the week, after Starship's first orbital flight.

(6) Refiners. The US diesel crack hit a record of about $102.20 a barrel. MPC, VLO, HF Sinclair and PSX logged 6 straight weeks of gains, and MPC was up 42% over that stretch.

(7) Cruise lines, as a turnaround rather than momentum. Carnival jumped 12% on Tuesday on a Q3 earnings beat and record bookings, but it was still down about 20% YTD before that.

(8) Quantum, as a rebound only. IonQ, D-Wave and Rigetti were bouncing late in September but are down YTD.

Gold is cooling and is NOT a hot theme right now. Spot gold was about $4,145.68 on Oct 2, down about 3.3% on the week and far below its Jan 29, 2026 all-time high above $5,595. Newmont was $114.67 on Oct 2 (Zacks).

Two things are unverified, so don't use them on air. First, one search summary said Atlassian rose 130.48% in Q3 (attributed to Barron's) and named Palantir and Strategy among Q3's best S&P 500 stocks. That summary looked unreliable because Strategy is likely not in the S&P 500, so treat it with caution. Second, the IBD 50 search returned no list dated October 2026.

Data gaps: I found no 50-day moving averages for any candidate. I found market cap only for Bloom Energy; every other approx_market_cap is "null (not found)". I don't know Everpure's former name; it may be the renamed Pure Storage, so check that before saying it on air.

- Momentum: INTC, P, BE, MPC (MU as a backup)
- Social: SPCX
- Sleeper: CCL or IONQ
